messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I'm calling to refill my mom's blood pressure med. Denise Carter, July 2nd, 1962. The lisinopril.
AGENT (LATEST): I'll verify your mom's information and look up her prescriptions. Great! I found her lisinopril 10 milligrams with two refills available at Harbor Pharmacy H-302. I'll queue that refill for you now. Perfect! Her lisinopril 10 milligrams for blood pressure is queued and ready tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at Harbor Pharmacy H-302. Is there anything else I can help with?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, queue_refill]

CONDITIONS:
asked_1: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Caller is her son Jamal Carter"
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Store is H-302"
stop_0: Agent confirms the refill and a ready time.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"asked_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask about caller's identity/relationship"}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent stated store, did not ask about it"}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirmed refill queued and ready at 10am"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
